Commentary.Commentary: As the saying goes, never judge a pitch until both sides have batted on it. Let's wait to see how the pitch behaves when India are batting. Remember, England only have a couple of spinners and they are playing four seamers. The series is at stake for England, they will want to stay on top in this game. Let's see how they go, join us in a while for India's reply.

England were once again rescued by the lower order with Jos Buttler playing well for his 76. He got good support from the other end as the Indian bowlers failed to show the discipline they have so far in the series. Ashwin and Jadeja did the bulk of the bowling and shared ten wickets between them. Both of them got assistance from the wicket and Kohli persisted with them. The rest of the bowlers were not quite used as much, Kohli will think they have conceded a few too many given there were few chances which were put down.

That ends a very good effort from England with the bat! They had won the toss before as well but didn't make the most of it, they have posted exactly 400 here with some vital contributions. The debutant Keaton Jennings helped them get a great start and they were cruising at 230 for 2 before a mini collapse brought India back in the game.

OUT! Jadeja cleans it up for India! Buttler who was looking to attack went after Jadeja and got out of his crease early. The left-armer spotted that and bowled a little flatter and quicker arm ball. Buttler got completely deceived by it as he swung his arms in air but failed to connect it. The ball then went on to shatter the woodwork. That's the end of a great innings by Buttler! Jadeja claims his fourth! ENGLAND END THEIR INNINGS ON 400!
Anderson survives another delivery as he remains solid in defence.
Shortish delivery outside off, Buttler cuts it through backward point for a single, bringing up 400 for his team.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Landed outside off, Buttler leans ahead and defends.
Buttler once again gets to the pitch of the ball and blocks.
SIX! Clobbered it! Tossed up outside off, Buttler gets to the pitch of the ball and sends it over long on and into the stands. That's beautiful use of wrists there by Buttler!
And Anderson survives as he blocks the full delivery outside off.
Buttler plays it off the back foot towards mid on for a single.
Flighted delivery outside off, Jos prods forward in defence.
Beaten! Sharp turn beats the outside edge of the Buttler's bat as he looks to defend off the front foot.
Tossed up outside off, spinning away, driven with the spin through widish mid off for a brace.
Flatter delivery on leg, JB looks to flick but misses and gets hit on the thigh pad.
Wide outside off, an easy leave for the batsman. Poor delivery!
Tossed up outside off, Buttler gets to the pitch of the ball, eases it towards long on for a single.
Full on middle and off, swept to deep mid-wicket but Buttler didn't take the single.
Bye! Outside leg, Anderson looks to sweep but misses and so does the keeper. The ball runs behind towards short fine leg and they take a bye.
JAMES ANDERSON is the last man in.

OUT! Ashwin strikes once again! He bowled it on a flatter trajectory, landed it outside off, got the ball to turn in and bounce, making it difficult for batsman. Ball went back in his crease to defend but the extra bounce catches the outside edge of the bat and Parthiv Patel behind the stumps takes an excellent reflex catch. Well bowled, well taken but well played too, Ball. He stitched a 54-run stand with Buttler.
Landed outside off, defended solidly off the front foot.
Ball has called for the physio.

Shortish delivery outside off with some width on offer, Ball cuts it through backward point for a single. While playing the shot he has hurt his shoulder and seems to be in some pain. Replays show his left hand came off the bat during the shot.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Outside off, spinning away, blocked with the turn on the off side.
This time Ball uses his feet, gets to the pitch of the ball and drives to mid on.
Arm ball, landed outside off, Ball defends it late towards point.
Served full outside off, defended towards point.
RAVINDRA JADEJA to bowl from the other end.
Pitched up delivery, pushed to covers.
Full on middle and off, played with the spin towards widish mid on for a quick single.
Beaten! Landed outside off, Ball looks to defend it off the front foot, expecting spin but the ball doesn't spin much and beats the outside edge of the bat.
Variation from Ravi, serves it outside off, Ball plays it late towards point.
Off spinning delivery outside off, turning in, defended to point.
Tossed up outside off and straightaway Buttler uses his feet, gets to the pitch of the ball and drives through widish mid off for a single.

Welcome back for the second session of play! It is a vital one for India as they are behind in the game. They will want to wrap things up and get batting as early as possible while the visitors will want to delay it as much possible adding some quick runs. Out come JOS BUTTLER and JAKE BALL to bat. India begin with RAVICHANDRAN ASHWIN. Here we go...
DAY 2... SESSION 2...

Indian spinners looked sharp early on but then Buttler and Ball muted them. Kohli took new ball 10 minutes before Lunch but was unable to get a breakthrough. Will Kohli's men chip in with a couple of quick wickets and get in to bat or will this partnership hurt India more? Let's see when players get back for the second session of the day.

Everyone would have thought that India would cruise through the English tail but Jake Ball came in and played a stern innings. He along with Jos Buttler has stitched an unbeaten partnership of 51 runs. It is adding to the frustration of the Indian camp. Buttler played a superb innings, completing his 6th half century and is currently unbeaten on 64.

97 runs at the loss of 3 wickets will sum out an even session but in the context of this match and under the circumstances one would say that England have definitely won the session. The spin duo of Ashwin and Jadeja troubled the English lower middle order and took some early wickets by sending Stokes, Woakes and Rashid back to the dressing room.

Drama! Fuller outside off, almost a yorker, Ball looks to dig it out but seems to have missed it. The ball deflects off the keeper's pads and lobs towards first slip who takes the catch and appeals along with his teammates. Nothing from the umpire there since there was no bat there and the replays confirm the same. Parthiv Patel has a wry smile on his face and that says it all for India. That's LUNCH, DAY 2!
Landed on off, Ball comes forward and defends it towards second slip where Kohli dives to stop the ball.
Outside off, Ball is happy to let it go through.
Flatter again on the stumps, Ball keeps it out watchfully.
Too full on middle, Ball keeps it out off the inner half of the bat towards square leg.
Flatter on the pads, Ball fails to nudge it through.
RAVINDRA JADEJA is back into the attack for the last over before lunch.
On off, Ball dabs it through third man for a single.
Short again, angling on the stumps, Ball lets it go through safely.
Shorter length on off, Ball arches back and lets it go through over him.
50-run stand up between Buttler and Ball!
Buttler comes forward and pushes it towards covers for a single.
FOUR! Smart batting! Buttler walks across and clips this length ball through fine leg for a boundary.
Full outside off, Ball drives it towards mid off, who goes to his left, dives and stops the ball. A single taken.
Buttler pushes it towards point off his crease.
Shorter length on middle, Buttler takes his eyes off and goes for the pull but fails to connect. Patel has to leap to take the ball.
Good length outside off, Ball places it to deep point for a single.
Outside off, Buttler gets across and turns it towards mid on for a single.
Outside off, Buttler keeps it out from his crease.
Full outside off, Buttler gets across and drives it towards covers.
UMESH YADAV replaces Jayant Yadav.
This one is closer to the off stump, Ball is beaten on the inside half of the bat this time.
BEATEN! Full and outside off, Ball looks to play at it but is beaten.
Shorter length outside off, Ball gets out of the way quickly.
Lands it outside off, Ball defends it from his crease.
Deep point goes a bit square.
FOUR! What a shot, Ball! Full outside off, Ball crashes it through the cover region for a boundary. That was a superb shot!
Bowls it outside off on a fuller length, Ball lets it go through.
Second new ball has been taken by India. BHUVNESHWAR KUMAR will start the proceedings from this ball and will bowl to BALL.
Good effort, Rahul! Ball comes down and heaves it past Umesh Yadav, the fielder at short mid-wicket. Rahul dives nears the ropes and keeps the ball in play with a good effort. A run saved.
Tossed up outside off, spins in, Ball is hit on his pads. An appeal follows but nothing from the bowler. Replays show there was an inside edge.
Ball stays alert and in his crease and defends it watchfully.
Tossed up on off, Ball comes down to have a ball by going inside out over covers but ends up pushing it off the inner half towards short mid-wicket.
Landed outside off, Ball comes forward and defends it.
There is a deep mid-wicket in place now.
Floated on off, Buttler comes down and hits it through mid on for a single.
Bowls it outside off, no shot offered by Ball.
Ball gets in line and defends this one.

Ball comes down to work it through mid-wicket but gets a leading edge through covers. The throw comes in, Patel leaps, collects and looks to deflect it onto the stumps but fails to run him out since Ball had completed the second by then.
Ball defends it from his crease.
FOUR! That came out of nowhere! Bowls it fuller on the stumps, Ball slog sweeps it through mid-wicket for a boundary. Not sure if he picked it, it was more of a premeditated shot.
Flatter on middle, Ball just about gets his bat down in time to keep it out.
Ball comes down and clips it through mid-wicket for a single.
This time Ball keeps it out from his crease.

Tossed up outside off, Ball comes forward to defend with his bat and pad. The ball lobs towards short leg who takes the catch and appeals but nothing from the umpire. Rightly so, since there was no bat there and the replays confirm the same.
Bowls it outside off, Ball stays back and defends it at the last moment. That was risky.
Buttler comes down and clips it through mid on for a single.
Outside off, Buttler defends it from his crease. He stops the ball with his feet as it was threatening to go back to the stumps.
Ball stays in his crease and keeps this one out.
Quicker on off, Ball defends it off the outer edge towards Virat Kohli at second slip who dives and stops the ball.
Dabs it through point for a single.
Shorter again on the stumps, Buttler keeps it out.
Shorter on off, Buttler pushes it to point.

Shorter outside off, punched through covers for a single. The fielder is a touch slow and they attempt the second, Umesh Yadav comes across and fields the ball. Jadeja collects the throw and fires it onto the stumps. There is an appeal since Ball had leaped to get into the crease to complete the second. The replays show the feet landed just in time when the bails came off. A nervy moment that!
The onfield umpire refers it upstairs for a run out call against Jake Ball.
Bowls it on the middle and leg, Ball looks to pull it through but misses it all ends up.
Buttler slinks down the wicket and clips it through mid on for a single.

Works it past the leg slip fielder for a single.
Lannded outside off, comes in, Ball looks to defend but is hit on his pad. Mild appeal turned down.
6th Test fifty for Jos Buttler!
FIFTY! Floated outside off, Buttler works it through square leg for a single. He gets to his fifty, a hard earned one.

Outside off, wide enough for a leave from Ball.

Shorter on off, Ball stays back and defends it back down the wicket.
Landed outside off, Buttler looks to punch it but he is cramped for room and ends up pushing it towards the off side. Jadeja will have six balls at Ball at the other end.
Ashwin reminds Ball to stay in his crease at the non-striker's end.

Bowls it on off, Ball stays back and defends it watchfully.
Flatter on the pads, Ball nudges it towards the on side off his crease.
Fires on the stumps, Buttler just about keeps it out towards covers. He looks for a couple but has to settle with a single. Ball now has to face three balls from Jadeja.

Bowls it around off, Buttler again shapes to reverse sweep it but fails to make any contact. A loud appeal from the Indians, but nothing from the umpire. Replays show it was a good call again, since the impact was outside off.
FOUR! REVERSE! Landed outside off, Buttler unfurls a reverse sweep past the two slip fielders for a boundary. KL Rahul does not come across in time from deep point to cut it off.
Floated outside off, comes in, Ball comes forward and defends it.
Silly point comes in with leg slip, short leg.
Outside off, dabbed past the first slip fielder for a single. Jake Ball has a ball to survive here.
Shorter outside off, Buttler goes back and punches it to covers.
Buttler prods forward and defends it.
Shorter on middle, pulled down to fine leg off his crease but refuses the single.
Shorter on off, Buttler stays back and punches it back down the wicket.
JAKE BALL is the new man in!

OUT! Rashid leaves and has to leave now! Bowls the arm ball with a round arm action, Rashid leaves it for reason best known to him, but the ball keeps coming in. He watches the ball hit the top of off and Jadeja takes off. A brilliant ball that, Jadeja has been superb and he again gives India a timely wicket. He took one away from Rashid previously and this time he bowled it quick and angled it in. Good variations.
Rashid drives it towards covers from his crease.

Loud appeal for a catch but not given! Slanted on middle, Rashid comes forward to defend but seems to have missed it. Loud appeal from the Indians but the umpire stays put. Replays confirm that it was a top call since Rashid hit the ground with his bat at that time and there was no contact with the ball.

Dropped! Spinning into the pads, worked with the spin towards mid-wicket.

Full and outside off, blocked on the bounce, leaning ahead.

Full outside off, pushed to covers for a single.

Served outside off, Buttler unleashes his favourite reverse sweep but finds Rahul at backward point.
Off spinning delivery outside off, spinning in, Rashid prods forward in defence.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

Rashid looks to work it with the spin but gets off the inside half of his bat past leg slip for a boundary. There's a "catch it" call in between but the replay showed that the ball fell just short of Vijay at leg slip.
Tossed up outside off, Buttler gets to the pitch of the ball and drives it to long on for a single.
Spinning down leg, worked with the turn on the leg side.
Spinning away from outside off, defended with the turn to point.

OUT! Jadeja strikes! Once again Jadeja produces this magical delivery, which lands just outside off and turns sharply. This time the ball manages to catch the outside edge of Waokes' bat who prods forward in defence and Patel behind the stumps takes a good sharp catch. It's too good a delivery for the lower order right handed batsman. Jadeja finally reaps dividends for his efforts! Woakes has to walk back!
Shortish delivery outside off, CW gets back in his crease and defends.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

Between the legs! Once again there's some extra bounce which surprises Buttler. He looks to defend it from within the crease but the turn and bounce catches the inside edge of his bat and goes through his legs to short leg. That could easily have gone on to hit the stumps.
Shortish delivery outside off with some extra bounce, Jos defends it wristily on the leg side.
Tossed up outside off, Buttler gets forward but fails to get to the ball as it hits the front pad first and then the bat and goes back to the bowler.

Outside off, pushed towards covers by Buttler. That was a carrom ball by Ashwin.

Way outside off, Buttler sweeps it through square leg for a single. The batsmen spot Pujara and take him on, complete the second in time despite a direct hit at the striker's end. Patel bothers with an appeal but the umpire is not interested.
Buttler stays in his crease and turns it towards short leg.
Tossed up outside off, Buttler leans forward and turns it towards short leg.

EDGED! Outside off, Woakes stays back to defend but gets it off the outside edge towards third man. Kohli runs after it from first slip, he slips looking for the slide towards third man as Bhuvneshwar Kumar comes across from the deep. The throw is returned in time by Kumar as the batsmen take a couple of runs. Kohli's knee stuck into the ground and he rolled over. But he's fine now.

Shorter on middle, Woakes camps back and defends it down.

India appeal in unison but is turned down. Kohli once again decides to take the review. The Ball Tracker shows that the ball was just going to clip the leg stump, making it umpire's call. Beaten! Jadeja once again produces a gem against Buttler. Flights it nicely outside off, spinning away sharply. Buttler prods forward in defence but gets beaten by that sharp turn for the second time against Jadeja this morning.
Outside off again, spinning away, guided to point.
Outside off, spinning away, played with the turn through point for a single.
Ashwin pulls his length back and Buttler defends it watchfully.
Flighted outside off, defended carefully from within the crease.
Tossed up outside off, blocked on the bounce.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.

In the air...lands safely, just ahead of Pujara! Tossed up delivery outside off, luring Woakes to go for a biggie and he does. Woakes looks to smash it over mid on but mistimes it high in the air. Pujara from mid on runs towards the boundary and puts in a effort but still fails to get a hand to it. Kohli is frustrated with his player's effort and changes his position.
Served full outside off, CW defends off the front foot.
Full delivery on off. This time Buttler defends more carefully with a straight bat.
Peach of a delivery! Tossed up beautifully outside off, spinning away sharply, Buttler prods forward in defense but gets beaten by that sharp turn. That will create some doubts in his mind!
Buttler gets forward and taps it to silly point again.
Tossed up outside off, driven hard to the silly point fielder.
Served full on off, defended solidly.
Straying on pads, Jos tucks it fine behind square on the leg side for a brace.
Tossed up delivery around middle and leg, Woakes sweeps it and the ball hits Pandey (substitute) at short leg. That must be painful!
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Flighted delivery outside off, Woakes prods forward in defence and gets an inside edge onto the pads. A mild appeal goes around!
Spinning into the batsman from outside off, Woakes plays with the spin to mid-wicket.

Flatter outside off, punched towards covers. The non-striker wants a single but is sent back in time as Kohli has a shy at the bowler's end. No harm done.

Floated on middle, Buttler comes forward and defends it.
CHRIS WOAKES is the new man in. Also, that is the 23rd five-wicket haul for Ashwin in Tests!

OUT! Decision overturned! India strike early through Ashwin! That's his fifer! Tossed up beautifully around middle, Stokes looks to defend it across the line and gets beaten by the turn. The ball then goes past Parthiv into the hands of a forward diving Kohli at first slip. India start celebrating but the umpire says not out. India appeal for a catch at first slip which is not given, Kohli is confident and wants a review. Stokes shakes his head though.
Wide outside off, Stokes leaves it.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Leg bye! Tossed up outside off, Jos looks to sweep it but fails to connect and gets hit on the pads. The ball rolls towards third man and they cross for a leg bye.
Off spinning delivery around off, this time Buttler opts to stay in the crease and block it.

Turn and bounce! Ashwin gives it a nice flight drawing Buttler forward. Buttler comes out of the crease but gets beaten by the turn and bounce on it. The ball goes off his pads over the keeper. Kohli from first slip goes over there and grabs the ball.
Served full outside off, pushed on the bounce to mid off for a single.
Buttler defends more carefully this time.
Mild catch it shout! Tossed up outside off, Buttler looks to defend it off the front foot but the ball catches the outside half of his bat and goes past the man at silly point.
Spinning into the pads, Stokes nudges it past short leg for a single.

Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
RAVINDRA JADEJA to bowl from the other end.
Pitched up on the stumps, defended back to the bowler.

In the air...but safe! Flighted delivery on leg, Stokes goes for the sweep but fails to connect the ball cleanly. The ball goes off the top edge but falls short of Bhuvneshwar Kumar at deep backward square leg. Lucky escape! He has to be more careful.
Spinning away from the southpaw, guided towards point.
Buttler eases the overpitched delivery to long on for a single.
Off spinner, defended outside off, driven towards mid on off the inside half of the bat.
Tossed up delivery, Buttler drives it on the full to widish mid off.

Game time! The players are out in the middle. BEN STOKES and JOS BUTTLER are out to continue batting. Will they attack from the start or take their time? India have a second new ball which is due and will hope to strike early and get going, they begin with RAVICHANDRAN ASHWIN! He is bowling with the older ball only for now. Here we go...

PITCH REPORT - Sunil Gavaskar reckons the pitch is dry and hence the ball is turning as much it is. Opines that the turn is only going to be more and more. He spots areas on the deck which are starting to open up. Nasser Hussain adds that there has been more bounce on offer for the spinners. Gavaskar opines that if England score 80-90 more today, India will be on the back foot.

India will want to get into the England tail as soon as possible and restrict them. The visitors on the other hand, will hope to add as many as possible since batting is going to get difficult as the game goes on. England like to score quickly and Kohli hates going for too many. Whoever wins this first session is likely to stay in control of this game.

Hello everyone and welcome to the coverage of Day Two of the fourth Test between India and England at the Wankhede Stadium, Mumbai. The game stands even at the moment with the hosts coming back strongly in the final session after England began really well winning the first two. The pitch has thrown up a few tricks and how it plays today could  decide what could be a par score here.
DAY 2... SESSION 1....

Earlier in the day, the debutant Keaton Jennings scored a magnificent century to put England ahead. Now with Stokes and Buttler at the crease and bowlers to follow, it will be interesting to see how they go about their effort tomorrow. Will Kohli opt to take the new ball early and claim some quick wickets or will England launch a counter-attack and run away with the game? Let's see as a score of over 400 from here on could be defining in this game. Do join us tomorrow at 0930 IST for all the action on Day 2. Until then, goodbye and take care!

England were cruising when Ravichandran Ashwin landed a double blow sending both the set batsmen packing. He continued his heroics by taking the wicket of Bairstow and giving Stokes a nightmare of a time. However, Stokes survived and along with Buttler saw off the rest of the day. Ashwin was the best  bowler for India as the rest gave him good support but in patches.

So after winning the first two sessions of the day comfortably, the hosts have came back strongly and won the third. At one stage, there were 230 for 2 and ended on 288 for 5. The debutant Jennings and the all-rounder, Moeen Ali continued to play well with the latter completing his 9th Test fifty. They went on to stitch up a 94-run partnership for the third wicket.
Outside off, Stokes stays back and defends it watchfully. That's STUMPS, DAY 1!
Stokes comes forward and pushes it towards mid off, Jadeja looks to stop but the mid off fielder stops it.
Silly point in place now.
Very full outside off, Stokes defends it solidly.
Outside off, spins in, Stokes defends it back down in time.
SPIN! Bowls it outside off, comes in sharply, Stokes is hit on his body as he looks to let it go.
Floated outside off, Stokes gets across and defends it.
The fourth umpire is waiting with the new ball, at the boundary edge.
Floated on off, Buttler defends it from his crease.
Stokes works it through mid-wicket for a single.
Floated outside off, Stokes comes forward and defends it watchfully.
Buttler works it through mid-wicket for a single.
Floated outside off, Buttler gets in line and defends it.
FOUR! Put away! Shorter outside off, Buttler goes back and cuts it through covers for a boundary. A real loosener that from a tiring Ashwin!
RAVICHANDRAN ASHWIN returns for a bowl before stumps.
Buttler comes down and clips it through wide mid on for a single.
Shorter outside off, Stokes cuts it hard to sweeper cover for a single.
Floated on middle, Stokes defends it from his crease.
Floated on the stumps, Buttler gets into an awkward tangle but manages to push it through mid-wicket for a single.
Buttler gets across and clips it towards mid-wicket who dives and stops the ball.
Floated outside off, comes in a touch, Buttler defends it with an inside edge onto his pads.
Stokes comes forward and defends it.
FOUR! Floated on middle, Stokes works it down to the fine leg fence off his pads for a boundary.
Stokes gets in line and defends it.

NOT OUT! Another close review! Landed around off, comes in again, Stokes looks to clip it through but is beaten and rapped on the pads. The bowler goes up for an appeal but the umpire stays put. Jadeja is confident and wants Kohli to take the review. Parthiv Patel is not sure about it. The Ball Tracker though once again shows the impact to be umpire's call  but hitting the stumps and hence the on-field call stays. That was close!
A review has been taken by India for a lbw appeal  against Stokes.
Floated outside off, comes in, Stokes looks to defend but gets an inside edge.
Buttler works it towards mid-wicket from his crease and they cross for a single.
The minimum quota of overs in a day has been completed but still there's 15 minutes of play is still remaining. How many more over will India bowl?
Bowls it outside leg, Stokes pads it away.
Buttler works it through mid on for a quick single. Bhuvi fumbles at mid on and Parthiv is not happy about it.
Shorter on middle going away, Stokes pushes it through covers for a single.
EDGED! Too full on middle, Stokes dabs it towards the off side with an open face of the bat.
Landed on the stumps, Stokes comes forward and defends it.
Bowls it on leg, Buttler stays in his crease and defends it.
Stays in his crease and defends it back down the wicket.
Buttler this time defends it properly.
Floated on middle, Buttler comes forward to defend but gets an inside edge down to fine leg. Two runs taken.
Works this one towards mid on.
Quicker on off, Buttler pushes it to covers off his back foot.
Floated on middle, Buttler comes forward and defends it.
Both these batsmen are now playing for survival and have survived fairly well till now. Will Kohli take the new ball to change things?
Landed on the stumps, Stokes comes forward and defends it.
Stokes comes forward and pushes it to covers.
Floated on off, pushed towards covers by Stokes.
Fuller on off, comes down and clips it through mid on for a single.
Shorter outside off, cut through point for a single.
Bowled on the stumps, Stokes pushes it towards covers.
Bowled outside off, comes in sharply, Buttler does not pick the length, and lets it go through.
Buttler keeps it out from his crease.
Buttler gets in line and defends it.
FOUR! STREAKY! Outside off, Buttler goes for the punch but gets it off the edge down to third man fence past gully.
Buttler stays back and defends it in time.
Floated outside off, Stokes works it through mid on for a single.
JADEJA comes on for a bowl.
Shorter outside off, cut to covers for a single.
Floated outside off, Stokes defends it from his crease.
This time Buttler clips it through mid on for a single.
Buttler comes down to turn it through mid-wicket but the ball finds Jadeja at short mid-wicket.
Shorter outside off, not what you want to bowl, hit away to covers for a single.
Manish Pandey has now been told by Kohli to stand much closer.
JUST SHORT! Floated outside off, Stokes looks to defend but the ball dies down off the outside edge to Manish Pandey standing at second slip.
Stokes punches this one off the stumps for a single to sweeper cover.
Slower one on middle and leg, Stokes fails to pull this one. Good bowling this.
IN THE AIR BUT SHORT! Shorter on middle, Stokes looks to punch but is early and ends up pushing it on the bounce to mid on. He then practices playing the pull shot.
Quicker on the stumps, Stokes keeps it out from his crease.
Floated on off, Stokes pushes it towards covers.
Shorter on middle, Stokes stays back and defends it towards the on side.
Landed around off, Buttler comes forward and defends it.
Outside off, spins in, Buttler misses the line of the ball as the ball bounces to the keeper.
Floated outside off, Buttler defends it.
Buttler comes down the wicket and nudges it towards mid-wicket off his pads.
Buttler gets in line and defends it.
On middle and leg, Buttler dabs it short of the leg gully fielder.
Outside off, pushed towards covers by Stokes.
Floated outside off, spins away, Stokes cannot put to ball as the keeper fails to collect, Virat collects the ball at first slip.
Tossed up around off, spins away, Stokes is happy to let it go through.
Floated on middle, Stokes comes forward and defends it.
Served fuller on middle and leg, defended watchfully.
FOUR! Shortish delivery on pads, Stokes camps back and punches through mid-wicket for a boundary.
EDGED! Floated outside off, Buttler looks to defend but gets an inside edge through square leg.
REVERSE! Outside off, Buttler looks to reverse sweep this but fails to put bat to ball.
Stokes punches it through point for a single.
EDGED! Outside off, Stokes looks to defend but gets an outside edge. The ball runs down to third man past Virat Kohli at first slip. He does well to keep them to a couple.
Buttler leans across and clips it through mid on for a single.
Cut through point for a single.
Floated outside off, Stokes defends it with his bat and pad together. There is an appeal but it is signaled a no ball for overstepping.
Floated on middle, Buttler gets across and turns it towards mid-wicket.
This time Buttler stays back and defends it watchfully.
TURN! Bowls it outside off, spins in a long way, Buttler is beaten all ends up on his drive.
Floated outside off, Buttler looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Jos Buttler is the new man in!

OUT! Softest of dismissals! Ashwin bowls it around leg, Bairstow goes for his favorite sweep. He does not keep it down and hits it in the air towards backward square leg. Umesh Yadav gets under it and takes the catch. Ashwin takes off, he has four to his name and England are again playing with fire. Yes it is important to play positively and keep the scoreboard ticking but you do not need to hit the ball in the air to put pressure on the opposition. India won't mind this one bit, they will want to keep striking.
How many more overs will Kohli let his bowlers bowl before he opts for the new ball? Or will he continue with the old one till stumps today?
Bowls it down the leg side, Bairstow cannot clip it.
Second new ball is due!

NOT OUT! Landed outside off, the ball spins and bounces more on Stokes who is beaten on his forward press. The keeper and first slip appeals but nothing from Jayant. The reviews will be refreshed after this ball and hence they gamble with the review. The Snicko spots no edge and no evidence to overturn the decision.
Review has been taken by India against Stokes for a caught behind.
EDGED! Outside off, Stokes looks to drive but gets an outside edge which rolls towards point.
Floated outside off, pushed to the off side.
Floated outside off, Bairstow top edges his sweep through square leg for a single.
Shorter outside off, punched through covers for a single.
Floated outside off, Bairstow comes forward to defend but gets it off the inner half through square leg for a single.
Drinks break!
Fullish delivery outside off, blocked on the off side.
Shortish delivery, punched through covers for a single.
Ashwin pulls his length a touch back. JB camps back and defends.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
On pads, flicked nicely for a single.
Tossed up delivery on middle and leg, defended off the front foot.
FOUR! Tossed up outside off, JB gets to the pitch of the ball and looks to whip it but ends up getting off the inside half of the bat for a boundary through the mid-wicket region.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Short delivery and Stokes doesn't miss out on those. He punches it through covers for a single.
Beaten! Spinning away from around off, Stokes looks to defend but the away turn beats him. Stokes is having a nightmare over here!
Served on middle and leg, defended from within the crease.
Full outside off, Ben drives it through covers but the ball hits the silly point fielder and deflects back to the bowler.
JAYANT YADAV to bowl now. He has dismissed Bairstow twice before.
Shortish delivery, punched off the back foot to covers for a single. He will keep the strike.
Pitched outside off, defended off the front foot.
Risky leave! Arm ball by Ashwin, served outside off, Stokes opts to leave it. It could have cost him his wicket as it was too close to leave.
Superb delivery! Another variation form Ash! Served outside off, spinning away late with extra bounce, defended late to gully.
Tossed up outside off, spinning away, defended with the spin on the off side.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Fullish delivery outside off, Stokes gets down on one knee and slaps it to covers.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Spinning into the southpaw form outside off, played with the turn towards the mid-wicket fielder.
Pitched up delivery around middle, JB kneels down and sweeps through backward square leg for a single.
Outside off, Jonny prods forward in defence.
Straighter one, sliding into the batsman, Bairstow gets the bat down at the last moment and defends it back to the bowler.
Stokes is right forward and defends it watchfully with his bat and pad together.
Full outside off, Stokes drives it hard but finds the silly point fielder.
BEATEN! Floated on off, turns away after pitching, Stokes is opened up and beaten all ends up. Ashwin is pumped up!
Angled on the pads, turned through square leg for a single.
Shorter on middle, Bairstow goes back and works it to Rahul at leg gully.
Bowls it on middle, Bairstow gets across and clips it through mid-wicket. Jadeja gives it a chase, along with the fielder from square leg coming across, they keep the batsmen to a couple.
Flatter one outside off, defended from within the crease.
Served outside off, defended off the front foot.
Fullish delivery outside off, driven to mid off.
Pitched up delivery, gets to the pitch of the ball and defends it back to the bowler.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Sliding down leg, flicked through square leg for a single.

Beaten! Peach of a delivery! Ashwin tosses it up nicely and pitches it outside leg. Stokes looks to play it on the bounce but the sharp turn on it beats the outside edge of his bat and goes past the off stump. That will create some doubts in the batsman's mind.
Full outside off, driven to covers.
Outside off, spinning away, defended with the turn towards gully.
Beautiful delivery! Tossed up on middle and off, Stokes gets forward in defence but gets beaten as the ball turns away sharply and whiskers past the off stump.
Tossed up outside off, JB gets down on one knee and paddle sweeps it for a single to fine leg.
Outside off, spinning in, defended from within the crease.
Served outside off, Ben gets right behind the line of the delivery and blocks it.
Tossed outside off, Stokes once again gets across and defends the ball.
Stokes covers his stumps and blocks the ball on the bounce.

Shortish delivery outside off, defended solidly.
Spinning into the batsman, defended late. Stokes is being very watchful!
JADEJA has a change of ends.
Served around off, defended off the back foot.
Outside leg, Stokes in his typical style gets off the mark by placing it in the gap through mid-wicket.
BEN STOKES is the new man in. A slip in place for him along with a gully, silly point and leg slip.

OUT! Double blow from R. Ashwin! Tossed up beautifully outside off, drawing Jennings on the front foot.  Jennings obliges and looks to defend it off the front foot but the turn on this ball takes the ball away from the batsman, catches the outside edge of his bat and goes towards deep gully. Pujara who was just placed over there takes a excellent low catch, diving forward. The debutant has to walk back but what an innings it has been from him. Take a bow, Jennings!
The gully fielder is a bit deep now.
Served around middle and off, defended from within the crease.
JONNY BAIRSTOW comes out to bat.

OUT! In the air....taken! One shot too many for Moeen Ali! Tossed up on middle and leg, Ali once again goes for the sweep but ends up top edging the ball high in the air. Karun Nair places himself under the ball and completes the catch on the practice pitches in the square leg region on his knees though. Ashwin with the breakthrough straightaway with his first over of the session.
Floated on middle, Moeen defends it from his crease.
ASHWIN comes on for a bowl. Vital spell this for India and the bowler as well.
9th Test fifty for Moeen Ali!
Drops it short outside off, Ali punches it through covers for a single. He gets to his  fifty and raises his bat to acknowledge the applause.
Cuts this one through point for a single.
Slants it across Jennings who lets it go through.
India are not even collecting well! Floated outside off, Jennings throws his bat at it, he fails to connect. The keeper cannot collect, nor can Kohli catch that one.
Flatter on off, pushed towards mid off by Jennings.
Floated on off, Ali works it through mid on for a single.
Spinning into the southpaw, defended watchfully from within the crease.
Ali paddle sweeps the tossed up delivery for a single.

A chance! Spinning into the pads from around off, Ali looks to sweep it but gets an inside edge onto the pads and towards short leg. Pujara at short leg gets wrong-footed but the ball drops well short of him.
Fullish delivery on off, blocked well.
Outside off, spinning in, defended off the back foot.
Spinning into the pads, worked with the spin on the leg side for a single.

FOUR! That made a sweet sound! Tossed up on leg, Ali once again gets down on one knee and sweeps it powerfully through mid-wicket for a boundary.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Full on the pads, driven to mid on.
FOUR! In the gap for a boundary! Flights it on middle and off, Ali times his sweep perfectly and finds the gap in the mid-wicket region for a boundary.
Pitched up delivery, swept through behind square on the leg side for a single.
Ali stays in crease and defends the delivery off the back foot.
Jennings once again gets to the pitch of the ball and flicks with the spin for a single through forward square leg.
Keaton gets to the pitch of the ball and blocks it on the bounce.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Full and outside off, Ali looks to drive it away from his body but gets an outside edge past slip for a single.
Spinning down leg, played with the spin on the leg side.
Shortish ball, blocked off the back foot.
Served on middle and leg, defended straight back.
Fullish delivery outside off, driven to mid off.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Spinning away from the southpaw, cut to point.
FOUR! Tossed up on middle and leg, Jennings kneels down and sweeps through backward square leg for a boundary. He has swept, reverse swept the whole day against all Indian spinners!
Shortish delivery, played off the back foot to long on for a single.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Spinning down leg, Ali plays it with the spin on the leg side for a single.
SIX! Moeen Ali making his intent clear! Pitched up delivery around leg, spinning in, Ali gets to the pitch of the ball and lofts it into the stands over mid-wicket.
Fuller delivery outside off, defended off the front foot.
Spinning into the pads, worked on the leg side.

Sharp turn over there! From over the wicket, Yadav serves it around leg. The ball spins away sharply, surprising the batsman. Jennings is beaten all ends up off his back foot and can do nothing but just admire it!

Just short! Served around off, Ali looks to defend it with soft hands but a sharp turn catches the outside edge of the bat and falls just short of Kohli at first slip. The ball then runs away to third man, fetching Ali a single.
Sliding on the pads, defended to mid-wicket.
Straighter one outside off, Ali reads it early and leaves it.
Served fuller outside off, defended off the front foot.
Turn and bounce! Pitched outside off, spinning away, left alone watchfully.

In the air...but safe! Served around off, Ali looks to sweep but gets a top edge behind square for a single.
Spinning into the batsman, defended on the leg side.
Tossed up outside off, defended back to the bowler.
FOUR! What a way to start the proceedings of the third session! Shortish delivery, spinning into the pads, pulled through mid-wicket for a boundary. 200 up for England!
The players are out in the middle. KEATON JENNINGS and MOEEN ALI are back out in the middle to continue batting. India begin with Ravindra Jadeja. Here we go...
Day 1... Session 3....

India will be happy with the way they have bowled but they have not been that threatening. England bat deep and also score at a good rate so if India do not strike early after Tea, they will know that they could end up chasing the game, staring at a huge first innings total. A vital last session awaits us. Do join us in a while for it.

Another session that goes in favour of the visitors. They have lost just the one wicket and have scored at a decent clip. The Indians would have hoped for more wickets when they dismissed Root early after the break but both Ali and Jennings have then played England through to Tea with the odd nervy moment. They will know the importance to putting up a big first innings total, which they didn't in the last Test.
Length delivery outside off, tapped to covers. THAT'S TEA ON DAY 1!
Full and wide outside off again, left easily.
Slightly back of a length delivery, punched off the back foot for a single through point.

Replica of the previous delivery, Ali once again shoulders his arms.
Full and well wide of the off stump. Moeen Ali happily watches it get into the keeper's gloves.

Outside off, pushed to covers.

Length delivery outside off, defended with soft hands towards the cover region.

Shorter outside off, cut to deep point for a single.
Floated outside off, Jennings looks to defend this but is beaten all ends up.
Maiden Test century for Keaton Jennings! After surviving an early scare, he never looked back and took the Indian bowlers to all parts of the ground.

FOUR! HUNDRED! What a way to get your maiden Test ton! Flatter on off, Jennings goes for the reverse sweep and connects well. He gets it down to the third man fence for a boundary. He shares a smile, hugs Moeen Ali and then raises his bat to acknowledge the applause. What a knock it has been from the southpaw.
Landed outside off, no shot offered by Jennings.
Floated outside off, Jennings lets it go through.
Ali punches it through covers for a single to hand strike to Jennings who is on 96.
50-run stand up between Moeen and Jennings!
Angling into the southpaw, played with the angle to mid-wicket for a single.
Length delivery, defended from within the crease.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Straying on pads, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.

Angling into the batsman once again, Ali closes the face of his bat and takes a single. Jadeja runs towards the ball, picks it and hurls a throw at the striker's end. The ball hits Jennings' bat and runs towards third man. As the ball hits the bat, the batsmen decides against running for an overthrow.
Angling into the batsman, played across the line for a single through mid-wicket.
BHUVNESHWAR KUMAR is back on for a spell.
Yadav continues with a similar line and Ali defends it off the front foot once again.

Outside off, pushed through covers for a brace.

FOUR! Edged and ran away! The plan of coming from around the wicket almost works instantly. Length delivery outside off, Ali pushes at it looking to play away from his body and gets a thick outside edge. The ball flies towards the slip cordon where Kohli at the second slip dives to his full stretch to his left, gets a hand to it but fails to grab it. The ball runs away to the third man fence for a boundary.
Goes round the wicket.
Shortish delivery outside off, punched through mid on for a single.
Ashwin pulls his length a touch back this time, to this Ali defends from within the crease.

Full outside off, driven back to the bowler.
Shortish delivery on leg, Keaton plays it at awkwardly for a single through backward square leg.
Wide down the leg side, an easy leave for the batsman.
Bouncer once again and angling across, KJ ducks and leaves it with ease.
Banged in short, Jennings ducks under it and lets it go through.
Back of a length delivery, defended from within the crease.
Length delivery angling across, taped to point for a single.
Full outside off, pushed to covers.

Straighter one, sliding down leg, Jennings looks to play across line but misses it completely. The ball goes off his pads and in the hands of Nair at silly point. Indians appeal in unison but is turned down and rightly so as shown in the replays.
Fuller on middle and leg, defended to mid on once again.
Served on middle and leg, driven to mid on.
Tossed up around off, defended with the full face of his bat.
Length delivery outside off, taped through point for a single.
The batsman has worked it off his pads behind square. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Bouncer! Banged in short, Ali ducks to leave it.
Length delivery on middle and off, defended with a straight bat.
Back of a length delivery, defended from within the crease.
On the leg side, tucked behind square on the leg side for a single.

Shortish delivery, Jennings camps back and punches through covers for a single. This time Oxenford is in the throw's way and quickly gets away from the ball, bringing a smile on everyone's face on the ground.
Angling into the pads, Keaton plays it with the angle on the leg side.
Outside off, pushed to covers.

Tossed up on middle and leg, spinning away, Jennings looks to play it across the line but gets a leading edge in process. The ball is in air for a while but there is no silly point present to take the catch. Kohli is frustrated but he has himself to blame!
Tossed up on off, driven back to the bowler.
Pitched around leg, KJ looks for some easy picking on the leg side but fails to connect and gets hit on the pads.
Once again banged in short, this time going across the southpaw. Moeen Ali ducks backwards to let it sail through.
Full outside off, Ali shoulders his arms to let that one through.
A touch back of a length delivery, defended from within the crease.
That's what he was brought in for, to test Ali with the short ball. He bangs it in short, Ali sees that early and ducks to evade it.
Pitched outside off, angling away, defended with the angle on the off side.
Length delivery on middle and leg, defended with a straight bat.
UMESH YADAV to bowl now. Time for some short stuff to Ali?
Off-spinner on off, spinning away, Jennings looks to defend it off the front foot but gets it off the inside half of the bat to mid on.
Tossed up nicely around off, defended late off the front foot.
Full outside off, driven straight back.
Tossed up outside off, Moeen drives it with ease for a single through covers.

There has been a halt in play as Paul Reiffel went on the ground after getting hit by the ball on the back of his head. The England physios are out to treat him! It can be nasty as it can result in a concussion. So during this break, drinks have been taken as well! Marais Erasmus comes out to replace Paul.
Nudged through backward square leg for a single. The throw comes in from Bhuvneshwar Kumar in the deep and hits the square leg umpire, Paul Reiffel.

Ali pushes it through covers for a single.

Flatter on the pads, Ali camps back and keeps it out towards the on side.
Stays back and pushes it towards short mid-wicket.

Floated outside off, Ali sweeps it through backward square leg for a single.
Jennings pushes it towards covers for a single.

JADEJA comes on for a bowl.
Stays back and defends it towards Pujara who does well to stop the ball at mid on and prevents the single.

Floated on middle and leg, KJ defends it watchfully.

Outside off, Ali defends it off the outer half of the bat towards silly point.
BEAUTY! Floated on middle, Ali comes forward to defend but is again beaten by the away turn. The ball misses the stumps by a whisker.
Fuller on middle, Jennings plays it back down the wicket.
An easy leave for Keaton outside off.
Drives it to mid off but not in the gap.
Jennings comes forward and defends this one.

FOUR! Floated outside off, driven hard through covers. Kumar looks to stop it with his feet but falls over and rolls into the fence. That could have been nasty.  Replays show his knee got stuck into the ground as he tried to slide to stop the ball. 150 up for England!
FOUR! Intent! Floated outside off, Jennings gets down on this one and unfurls a reverse sweep through backward point for a boundary. He has not been afraid to play his shots here.
Ali comes forward and defends it from his crease.
Floated outside off, Ali looks to punch it through but seems to have missed it. The keeper, first slip are contemplating a review but thankfully do not go for it.
Flatter on the pads, tucked to backward square leg for a single.

Ashwin and Kohli have a chat about the field.

JAYANT YADAV to bowl now.
Stays back and defends it from hsi crease.

Floated outside off, Ali pushes it through covers for a couple.
Ali comes forward and defends it.
TURN! Bowls it on middle, spins away and Ali is beaten all ends up as he pushes forward to defend that one. Good ball, that!
Floated outside off, Ali comes forward and pushes it towards covers.
Landed on the stumps, Jennings gets in line and defends it.
Jennings stays back and defends it.
Ali looks to defend but gets an inside edge through backward square leg for a single.
Landed around off, Ali is rock solid in his defense.
Outside off, Ali defends it well.
Just short! Floated outside off, Ali looks to drive but gets it towards Pujara at short mid-wicket who dives forward to take it but the ball drops short of him.
A touch fuller on off, Jennings defends it back.
Shorter on off, zips off the pitch, Jennings defends it late.
Landed on middle, Ali looks to clip but gets it through gully for a single to get off the mark.
Floated on middle, Ali comes forward and defends it.
MOEEN ALI walks in next!

OUT! Easy as you like! Floated outside off, tempts Root into the drive. The ball gets the outside edge and flies to Virat Kohli who was going to his right but adjusts well to take it to his left. Sharp reflex catch and Ashwin is relieved. Replays show that the ball stuck between his wrists, lucky there, Kohli. Patel would be the most relieved man. A vital wicket for India and just at the right time as well. That was a poor shot from Root too.
Floated on the stumps, Root is solid in his defense.
Jennings stays in his crease and defends it.
Root pushes it to covers for a single.

CHANCE MISSED! Fuller on the stumps, Root looks to clip it through but is beaten. The ball flies past the keeper and that is a stumping chance missed. That went really quickly past Patel. How costly will it be?
Quicker outside off, Root comes forward and pushes it to the off side.
Lunges forward and defends it back to the bowler.
Floated outside off, Root comes forward, opens the face of the bat to push it towards point.
Floated outside off, Root leans across and gets it to long on for a single.
Full toss on the pads, worked through mid-wicket for a single.
This time he stays in crease, lunges forward and defends it.
Floated on middle, Jennings comes down and defends it watchfully.
Bowls it outside off, turns in, Root tucks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Full outside off, Root drives it towards mid off and Root has to get back in his crease as he was looking for a single.
Jennings gets across and defends it watchfully.
Floated on middle, Jennings keeps it out.
Jennings clips it towards mid on where Rahul again returns the ball quickly.
Landed on middle, Root clips it towards mid on for a single.
Floated outside off, Root comes forward and pushes it to covers.
Flatter on the stumps, played back to the bowler by Root.
Landed around off, Root lunges forward and clips it through mid-wicket for a run.
Floated outside off, Root shapes to flick but gets it off the inner half through square leg for a couple.
Root comes down and turns it towards KL Rahul at mid on. Rahul looks to hit the stumps at the bowler's end but misses.
This time Root has to stay back and he defends it watchfully.
Outside off, Root presses forward and pushes it to covers.
Floated outside off, Root comes forward and defends it.
Quicker around off, Jennings defends it watchfully.
Landed around off, pushed towards point for a single.
FOUR! In the gap! Floated outside off, Root drives it through covers. KL Rahul dives at covers but cannot stop the ball. The ball races away to the fence.
Outside off, comes in, Jennings turns it through mid-wicket off the inner half for a single.
Flatter on off, Root stays back and turns it through mid-wicket for a single.
Too full outside off, Root pushes it towards covers.
Outside off, comes down the wicket and yorks himself a touch. Ashwin goes to his right and stops the ball.
This time he gets in line and pushes it back.
Tossed up outside off, this one holds its line and goes straight. Jennings leaves it but not sure if he picked it.
Floated outside off, Jennings comes forward to defend but is beaten by the away turn.
Root turns it through mid-wicket for a single. Slight fumble by Jayant but no harm done.
Landed outside off, Root goes back and punches it to covers.
Ravichandran Ashwin comes on from the other end. A slip and a short leg in place.
Floated outside off, comes in, Jennings defends it with his bad and pad together.
Tossed up outside off, Jennings pads it away.
Floated outside off, Root waits for it and squeezes it to third man for a single. He wants a second but is sent back in time.
Landed on middle, Jennings drives it through mid on for a single.
Fuller on off, clipped towards short mid-wicket by Jennings.
Bowls it outside off, Root drives it through covers where Jayant dives over it and concedes a single.

Welcome back for the second session of play. The players are out in the middle. JOE ROOT and KEATON JENNINGS head out to the middle to continue batting. They will be looking to stay positive and keep the pressure on India.  How will India respond? They must have had a chat at the break too, they begin with Ravindra Jadeja!
Day 1... Session 2....

Jennings had a few nervy moments before growing in confidence as the game went on. He registered his maiden Test fifty and is looking set for a big score here. England's intent has been to stay positive, hitting a lot of boundaries - they have already hit 13 and with Kohli predominantly not wanting to give the boundaries, this could set up a fascinating second session. Apart from Jadeja, no one looked in control for India and they will need a much better effort post lunch. Do join us in a while for it.

Brilliant start for England! Everything has gone their way so far, the toss, the chances and the first session despite the wicket of Alastair Cook. The visitors began positively and kept the scoreboard ticking all the time. What should have been countered by some tight bowling by the hosts, was followed by some non-threatening bowling with a spread field.
Wide outside off, an easy leave for the batsman. THAT SHALL BE LUNCH ON DAY 1!
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Root survives! Nipping back in from a good length outside off, Root looks to push it away from his body and gets lucky as the ball catches the inside edge and runs towards fine leg for a single.
Once again on the pads, worked down leg for a single.
Straying on pads, tucked down fine behind square on the leg side for a single.
A touch fullish, defended with a straight bat towards mid on.
UMESH YADAV to bowl the final over before lunch.
Once again Jennings defends the incoming delivery with the spin on the leg side.
Spinning into the southpaw, flicked with the turn on the leg side.
FOUR! There it is! Once again the debutant kneels down and uses the sweep shot to the fullest as the ball races down to the leg side fence!
Jennings once again drives the fuller delivery to mid on.
Spinning into the batsman, driven with the spin to mid on.

A loud appeal turned down! Served outside off, doesn't spin much. Root looks to play it on the front foot and gets hit on the front pad first and then the ball goes on to get off the bat towards point for a single. India think of a review but Jadeja then thinks against it. it proves to be a wise decision as the impact was outside off.
Shortish delivery outside off, played to point for a single.
Full outside off, driven through mid off.
On middle and leg, clipped to mid-wicket.
After the previous tossed up delivery getting hit for a boundary, Yadav pulls his length back and bowls it outside off, Jennings camps back and punches through covers for a single.
FOUR! One bounce into the fence! Tossed up delivery, KJ uses his feet, gets to the pitch of the ball and lofts it over mid on for a boundary.
Spinning into the debutant, defended with a straight bat.
This time Root watches the ball carefully and defends at the last moment.
Beaten! Some turn there for Jaddu! He pitches it outside off and gets the ball to turn away sharply. Root prods forward in defence but gets beaten by the turn. Good bowling there!
Served outside off, spinning away form Root, Root defends it watchfully.
Fuller on off and spinning into the pads, Jennings gets it off the toe end of the bat towards long on for a single.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Served fuller around off, defended back to the bowler.
Shortish delivery, punched off the back foot on the off side for a single.
Full outside off, driven to mid off.
Fuller on the boots, clipped with ease through square leg for a single. Root gets off the mark!
Short and wide, punched off the back foot for a single through covers.
Served around off once again, KJ prods ahead in defence.
Around off, Jennings defends it late.
Arm ball, sliding into the pads, defended with the angle on the leg side.
Tossed up on middle and off, defended watchfully.
Jadeja pulls his length a touch back, and gets a slight away turn, Root defends it from within the crease.
JOE ROOT is the new man in.

OUT! What have you done, Cook? Floated outside off, Cook wants to have a piece of him, he comes down the wicket to heave it over mid-wicket but the ball goes through him and the keeper, Patel has the easiest of the stumpings to complete. Replays actually suggest he had fumbled a touch since the ball bounced a bit more but he did well to finish the job. What a strike for India, they were right under the pump and Jadeja has given them a breakthrough in his very first over. England will have mixed feelings, they were hitting the gaps and putting pressure. Was there a need for such a shot just before lunch? Easier to say with hindsight though.
Outside off, Cook plants his front foot across and turns it towards mid on.
Bowls it outside off, it is wide enough for Cook to pad it away.
RAVINDRA JADEJA comes on for a bowl. India desperate for a wicket now.
Served fuller outside off, driven through to long off for a single.
Shortish delivery outside off, cut through point for a single.
Flighted delivery, Jennings gets to the pitch of the ball and blocks the ball on the bounce.
Spinning into the pads, driven to mid on.
Fuller outside off, eased to long off for a single.
FOUR! Tossed up on the stumps, Cook, who is looking confident now gets to the pitch of the ball and lofts it over the bowler's head for a boundary.
Two slips in place now!
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Maiden Test fifty for Keaton Jennings!
That's his 50! What an innings! Served around leg, Jennings gets down on one knee and sweeps through to fine leg for a brace.
Edged but safe! Served outside off, spinning away, Cook looks to defend it off the front foot but gets an outside edge past Pujara at silly point for a single. Another scare which Cook survives!
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! Tossed up outside off, Cook plants his front foot near the pitch of the ball and drives confidently past the diving mid off for a boundary.
FOUR! Confident shot! Served on middle and leg, Cook drives it beautifully through mid on for a boundary.
Arm ball, sliding down leg, Cook looks to defend it off the front foot but misreads the line and gets struck on the back pad. A mild appeal goes around which is turned down by the umpire.
Fuller on the stumps, defended solidly from within the crease.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
Beaten! Turn on offer for Yadav. He serves it around off, Jennings looks to defend it off the front foot but gets beaten by the away turn.
Tossed up on off, driven firmly but straight to the fielder in covers.
Full delivery outside off, KJ presents a front foot defence.
Served fuller outside off, defended back to the bowler.
Driven on the up through covers by Cook. Nair at the fence, fumbles a touch but does well to not let the ball go through to the ropes. Two runs taken.
Goes over the wicket, bowls it on middle and off, Cook comes forward and defends it towards covers.
Drops it short on middle, Jennings has all the time to punch it down to long off for a single.
Shorter on middle, Cook camps back and cuts it through covers for a single.
On the pads again, this time Cook whips it through square leg for a couple of runs.
Flatter on the pads, Cook fails to clip it through.
Extra bounce once again! Turning away from the southpaw, Jennings looks to play it on the off side but gets beaten by the extra bounce.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Full outside off, pushed through covers for a single. Good rotation of strike!
KJ once again sweeps the fuller delivery and takes a single.
Sliding down leg, Jennings kneels down and sweeps behind square on the leg side for a couple. Jennings has not been shy in sweeping the Indian spinners the whole morning.
Pitched outside off, Jennings defends it with a straight bat.
JAYANT YADAV to bowl, with two left-handed batsman at the crease.
Served outside off, defended from within the crease.

Cook survives a scare! Beautiful bowling by Ashwin. He tosses it up outside leg, Cook looks to defend it by getting behind the line of the delivery but gets beaten all ends up by the turn and bounce. Luckily for him, the ball misses the top of the stump and sails over. Parthiv behind the stumps also fails to collect the ball and a stumping chance goes by. It was a difficult one but still a chance.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Served on middle and leg, turning away from the southpaw, defended with the spin on the off side.
Pitched outside leg once again, Jennings sweeps it behind square on the leg side for a single.
Ashwin comes from over the wicket. Serves it outside leg, defended back to the bowler.
Angling into the pads, flicked towards mid-wicket for a single.
Outside off, closer to the stumps this time. Jennings make a close watchful leave. A touch risky by the debutant.
FOUR! Driven! Full and width on offer, Jennings doesn't miss on such looseners. He latches onto it in a flash and drives sweetly through covers for a boundary.
Fuller and angling into the stumps, defended back to the bowler.
Full outside off, another easy leave for the batsman.
Length delivery outside off, KJ leaves it alone.
Ashwin pulls back his length this time and pitches it outside off. The debutant comfortably sits back and cuts it through point for a single. He will keep the strike.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Served fuller on middle and leg, defended back to the bowler.
Sliding down leg, this time Jennings clips it through mid-wicket for another brace.
Tossed up outside off, defended solidly off the front foot.
Carrom ball on middle, turning into the pads, Jennings gets it past the leg slip through to fine leg and picks up a couple.
Length delivery, KJ cuts it through point for a single.
FOUR! Shot! Beautiful shot! Full outside off and angling across, looking to find the outside edge of the bat. However, Jennings confidently drives it through covers for a boundary.
Touch back of a length delivery, Cook pulls it through mid-wicket for a single.
Angling away from the batsman, Cook leaves it alone.
Angling across the southpaw, Jennings stays in his crease and opens the face of the bat for a single through point.
Full outside off, pushed to covers.
UMESH YADAV returns for a spell. A break for Kumar at last.
Sliding on the pads, clipped to fine leg for a single.
Short and wide outside off, Jennings stays back and cuts through point for a couple.
Tossed up, inviting Jennings forward and the debutant obliges as he comes out of the crease and drives it back to the bowler.
Served outside off, once again KJ prods forward in defence.
Served on off, Jennings plants his front foot firmly and defends.
Tossed up on middle and off, eased to long off for a single.

Drinks break! A brilliant first hour for England. They had their scares but again as has been the case, India have been generous on the field. They will want to break this stand and get back in the game.
FOUR! Confident batting! Shorter length on off, Jennings picks it early and pulls it through backward square leg for a boundary. Superb shot to end the over.
Digs it short but wide of off, left over by Jennings.
FOUR! Superb timing! Fuller outside off, Jennings comes forward and drives it wide of Ashwin at mid off. He gives it a chase but the ball was always winning the race.
Shorter outside off, no shot offered by Jennings.
Full on off, Jennings drives it back down the wicket to the bowler.
Angled on the stumps, Jennings turns it towards short mid-wicket.
A short mid-wicket in place now.
Cook comes in line and pushes it to covers.
There is a silly point in place, it is standing a bit deep. It is for the push drive in the air.
Shorter outside off, comes in, Jennings punches it through point for a single.
Floated outside off, turn and bounce for Ashwin but no shot offered.
Angles it on the pads, Jennings turns it towards the on side.
Floated on off, Jennings comes forward and defends it.
Cook comes forward and drives it through mid off for a single.
Cook turns it down to fine leg for a single to end the over.

Angled on the stumps, Cook works it towards mid-wicket off the inner half of the bat for a single. There is an overthrow at the bowler's end and they get an extra run. Kohli is not happy, he asks if the run was legal since the ball was dead when the throw came in. The umpires come together to discuss but it stays as it is.
Outside off, Cook looks to defend but does so off the inner half.
Fuller but on the pads, Cook is hit on his pads as he fails to clip it away.
Full outside off, Cook drives it back down the ground towards mid off.
Outside off, Cook comes forward and defends it.
Jennings comes forward and drives it to extra cover.
In the air...but safe! Floated on middle, Jennings is early into his shot and he ends up pushing it in the air towards the mid on region.
Gets in line and defends it.
Floated on the pads, Jennings turns it towards short mid-wicket. Patel screams 'Ash, Ash' but noway was Ashwin even going to attempt to field that.
Jennings comes forward again and pushes it towards the off side.
Floated on off, Jennings comes forward and defends it.
2,000 Test runs against India for Alastair Cook!
FOUR! Good shot! This time Cook gets across and punches it down the ground through mid on for a superb boundary. This is a good start for England!
Full outside off, Cook pushes it back down towards mid off. Bhuvi sticks out his right hand but cannot stop the ball. The mid off fielder comes across and fields it.
Cook covers the line and defends it back.
A touch short outside off, Cook punches it towards short cover.

Slanted down the leg side, Cook looks to clip it through but is beaten. Shouts of catch but there didn't seem to be any bat there and anyway the ball fell short of Patel who could not collect it cleanly.
Shorter length outside off, Jennings goes for the pull but does not quite control it. The mid-wicket fielder comes across and keeps it to three. That was a bit of a drag from Keaton.
Tossed up outside off, Cook is early into his shot and ends up pushing it on the bounce to the short cover fielder. That dipped on Cook.
Floated on the stumps, Cook again reaches out for it and pushes it back to the bowler.
Loopy on middle and off, Cook prods forward and defends it.
Tossed up on middle, Cook pushes it back to the bowler.
Loopy on middle, Jennings gets across and paddle sweeps it to fine leg for a run.
Floated on the stumps, Jennings defends it watchfully.
Tucks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Jennings covers the line and defends this one.
Full on off, Jennings comes forward and defends it watchfully.
Full outside off, Jennings lets it go through and does not fall for the tempting cover drive.
Full outside off, Jennings drives it towards short cover from his crease.
Good length outside off, Jennings defends it towards the point region with an open face.
Full outside off, Cook drives it through covers. Pandey in the deep, substitute for Kohli, does well to keep it to a couple.
Cook prods forward and defends it to covers.
Loopy on the stumps, Jennings tucks it towards square leg for a single.
Cook turns it through square leg for a single.
Turn and bounce! Tossed up on middle, spins away a touch, Cook shapes to sweep but is beaten all ends up and gets hit on the pads. Mild appeal turned down.
Floated on off, Cook comes forward and defends it watchfully.
Time for spin! Ravichandran Ashwin comes into the attack.
Fuller outside off, Jennings looks to defend it late but gets a bottom edge into the ground and towards the slip cordon.
Bowls it outside off, Jennings stays besides the line and defends it.
This one is wide enough for Jennings to leave.

NOT OUT! A review gone down the drain! Bowls it outside off, fuller length, Jennings looks to defend with his bat and pad together but get struck on the pad first. The players go up in an appeal but the umpire stays put. Ashwin from mid off comes in and suggests that they should review it. Kohli goes for it but to India's dismay, the Ball Tracker shows that the impact was the umpire's call and hence the decision stays as it is.
Ashwin has convinced Kohli to go for an lbw review against Jennings.
Jennings covers the line and defends it watchfully.
Sprays it wide outside off, Cook cuts it down to the deep point fielder for a single.
Slanted it outside off, no shot offered by Jennings.
Hurls it on off, comes in, Jennings looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto his box. That must have hurt.
Shorter length outside off, Jennings lets it go through.
Bowled on the stumps, Jennings defends it back down the wicket.
Shorter on the pads, Cook gets across and works it through square leg for a single.
Full outside off, Cook comes forward and defends it back to the bowler.
Stays in his crease and keeps it out.
This one is bowled on the stumps, Jennings gets squared up and defends it somehow with a straight bat.
First official warning for Bhuvneshwar Kumar for following through in the danger area!
Outside off, left alone by Jennings.
Bouncer! Shorter length on the stumps, but it is too short and Jennings lets it go over him. The umpire has a look at the followthrough area.
Third slip comes out and is at extra cover.
Angled outside off, Jennings places it towards covers. Ashwin again takes a start from mid off but stops running. The deep cover fielder cuts it out and keeps them to a couple.
Bowls it on the pads, Cook tucks it towards square leg for a single.
Change of bat for Jennings. He has broken his bat already.
FOUR! Take that, Umesh! Shorter length on middle, Jennings was waiting for it and he pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
FOUR! Off the mark! Shorter length outside off, Jennings goes after the width and cuts it behind point for a boundary. That went off the toe end of the bat.
This time Jennings is right forward and defends it.

DROPPED! Shorter length on off, Jennings looks to punch it on the up. The ball bounces more, gets it off the outer half and lobs towards Karun Nair at gully who goes towards his left, gets a hand to it but cannot hold onto the chance. India have put down a chance, a tough one but these need to be taken.
BEATEN! Hurls it on off, Jennings looks to drive it from his crease but is beaten all ends up.
Bowls it on middle, Jennings stays in his crease and keeps it out.
Short outside off, Cook throws his bat at it and is beaten all ends up.
Cook gets in line and defends it.

Dropped? Nope! FOUR! Bowls it on the stumps, Cook looks to clip it through mid-wicket but gets a leading edge. The ball flies quickly to the left of Karun Nair at gully and races into the third man fence.
Full outside off, Cook pushes it through covers. Ashwin runs from mid off but gives up earlier than needed. The cover fielder gets across and stops them. A couple taken.
A friendly warning for Bhuvi for followthrough in the danger area on the pitch.
Fuller but on the pads, Jennings cannot clip it through. Cook calls him through for a leg bye.
Fuller outside off, Cook stays in his crease and defends it with an slightly open face of the bat for a single towards covers.
Back of a length on off, Jennings defends it solidly. That made a very good noise.
Shorter length on middle and leg, Jennings looks to pull but then withdraws from the shot and is hit on his body.
Full outside off, swings away, Jennings lets it go through.
Shorter outside off, Jennings watches it go safely.
Slanted outside off, no shot offered by Jennings.
Bowls it outside off, shapes in a touch, Jennings lets it go watchfully.
UMESH YADAV to bowl from the other end.
Fuller in length on off, Cook comes forward and defends it.
Full outside off, swings away, Cook lets it go through safely.
Opts to go around the wicket.
Slanted wide outside off, Cook shoulders his arms to it.
Already the short leg has been taken off! Bhuvi slips one down the leg side, Cook shapes to flick at first, but misses and then raises his bat to let it go.
Fuller outside off, Cook pushes at it and gets it through the inside half of the bat for a couple of runs through mid-wicket.
Bowls it on middle, Cook covers the line and defends it back down the wicket.

Game time! The players are out in the middle. KEATON JENNINGS and ALASTAIR COOK are out to open the batting for England. India begin with BHUVNESHWAR KUMAR! Three slips in place for him along with a gully. Interestingly, a short leg has been placed first up for Bhuvi. Here we go...
The teams are out in the middle for the national anthems.
England XI - Alastair Cook (c), Keaton Jennings, Joe Root, Moeen Ali, Ben Stokes, Jonny Bairstow (wk), Jos Buttler, Chris Woakes, Adil Rashid, James Anderson, Jake Ball.
India XI - Murali Vijay, Lokesh Rahul, Cheteshwar Pujara, Virat Kohli (c), Karun Nair, Ravichandran Ashwin, Parthiv Patel (wk), Ravindra Jadeja, Jayant Yadav, Bhuvneshwar Kumar, Umesh Yadav.

Virat Kohli too opines that it is a good wicket. He adds that he does not think it is a bad toss to lose. Opines that the seamers will get more help compared to Mohali and they are not looking just at the game but at the series as a whole.

Alastair Cook calls it a good batting deck, adds that it was nice to get a break. Is happy that they get good support at Wankhede. Mentions that it is nice turning up to a ground where they have had success before.

TOSS - ENGLAND WIN THE TOSS AND OPT TO BAT.  Another vital toss won by England. A couple of changes for both the teams, Keaton Jennings was handed his England Test cap by Sir Ian Botham. Jake Ball comes in for Gareth Batty. India replace Mohammed Shami and Ajinkya Rahane with Bhuvneshwar Kumar and KL Rahul.

PITCH REPORT - Sunil Gavaskar reckons that there are cracks on the pitch, on the dry side, the ball will come onto the bat nicely for the first two days. Mentions that the ball will turn more from one of the ends, the seamers will get help in the first session everyday. Opines that the ball may start turning as early as the last session today.

Hello everyone and welcome to the coverage of the fourth Test between India and England at the Wankhede Stadium, Mumbai. The hosts are sitting pretty with a 2-0 lead in the five-match Test series and will be looking to seal it here itself. The visitors will take inspiration from the fact that the last time they played in Mumbai, they put in one of England's best Test performances. Both teams have their injury woes and it will be interesting to see what combinations both teams go in with.
